methylTFR: transcription factor activity from DNA methylation

Source: R/zzz.R
methylTFR-package.Rd

Scores the methylation footprint at transcription factor binding sites and returns one bias-corrected score per motif and sample.

Getting started

  1. Import methylation calls with readMethylome().

  2. Load annotations from methylTFRAnnotationHg38 (getTFbindsites(), getGCfreq(), getGenomeGC()).

  3. Compute scores with runMethylTFR() or runMethylTFRFromRnBeads().

  4. Explore with deviations(), deviationZScores(), computeZScoreVariability(), differentialDeviationTest(), plotMotifFootprint() and plotExpectedFootprint().

See vignette("methylTFR") for a worked example.
